title: Player Perks
description: This project adds perks to minecraft which you can access in the pause menu
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3552d0e4d86bc0e7708385bd0fda28ebb2d141bf.png)

- **PERM** - it means that if you equip the perk once you will be able to equip it again without needing the requirements
- **PERK** - perk is something like a class that gives you buffs, to unlock perks you need to complete requirements, you can equip only perk at once

## Perks
Info about all the perks is in the game but if you don't want to check them in the game here is the list of all perks

### Movement

- **Speedy** - Gives speed 2, a blue trail appears when you run - You need to purchase with 30 levels (PERM, [Speed/Particles/Run/Slot 2])
  
- **Slider** - This perk lets you slide when you run and sneak at the same time, you have smaller size when sliding - Equip this perk when you are in the boat on the ice (PERM, [Small/Speed/Run+Shift])
  
- **Levitator** - When you crouch you get levitation and speed 3, and you always have slow falling - Equip this perk when you have levitation and slow falling effect at the same time (PERM, [Fly/Shift/Particles/Slot 2], Added in 1.1.0)
  
### Defense
  
- **Sneaky** - When you crouch you become invisible - Equip this perk when you have invisibility effect (PERM, [Invis/Shift/Slot 2])
- **Block** - You can block anything with 5 seconds cooldown when you shift (It gives resistance 5 for 1 second) - You need to have no armor and 15 levels (NON-PERM, [Resistance/Shift/Cooldown/Particles], Added in 1.2.0)
- **Turtle** - When you crouch you have resistance 5 and slowness 5, when you uncrouch you will still have slowness 5 for 2 seconds - You need to equip this perk when you have resistance and slowness at the same time (PERM, [Resistance/Slowness/Shift/Particles], Added in 1.3.0)

### Damage

- **Flame** - When you crouch you spawn fire beneath you and gives infinite fire resistance - You need to equip this perk while having fire resistance and standing in lava (PERM, Damage/Defense, [Blocks/Shift/Slot 2])
- **Evoker** - You can summon 8 evoker fangs in front of you and deals 5 damage to nearest entity in 5 blocks distance with a 5 seconds cooldown when you shift - kill atleast 3 evokers (PERM, [Shift/Cooldown/Aura/Particles], Added in 1.4.0)

### Utility

- **Builder** - You can summon a 3x3 stone wall in front of you with 10 seconds cooldown when crouching - Build a 5 block tall pillar out of stone, NOT COBBLESTONE. (PERM. [Shift/Cooldown/Blocks], Added in 2.0.0)

## Perks format
Here's an explanation for the perk format

- **Parentheses** - In () there are **Attributes** that can say something about the perk, for example (NON-PERM, Defense/Movement, [Jump boost/Aura/Shift], Added in 7.7.7).
- **Categories** - This attribute looks like this: (Defense/Movement). It shows the categories for the perk, the first category is the main category, then there are subcategories, they are separated with / symbol.
- **Tags** - This attribute looks like this: ([Speed/Jump boost/Shift]). It shows the tags of the perk, tags are what the perk does, for example **levitator** perk let's you fly, and this perk has the **Fly** tag.

### Tags

- **Shift** - This tag says that the perk activates something when you shift, can be combined with run
- **Run** - This tag says that the perk activates something when you run, can be combined with shift
- **Fly** - This tag says that you can fly with this perk
- **(Effect)** - This tag can be any of the effects, it says that the perk can give you that effect
- **Aura** - This tag says that the perk can do something with something near you
- **Cooldown** - This tag means that the perk has cooldown, maybe for an ability or something else
- **Blocks** - This tag says that the perk does something with blocks
- **Particles** - This tag means that perk emits particles
- **Slot 2** - This tag means that the perk is able to equip on second slot

## FAQ
- How to access perks? - Press the **Perks** button in the pause menu
- How to unequip perk? - Press the **Unequip** button in the **Perks** menu
